change.problem: A 7B model often emits compact story keys such as chapter_1 instead of the full canonical schema, and generated names could leave old template labels or make the hero speak to themselves.
change.fix: Qwen/Ollama world drafting now uses a compact material prompt and smaller output budget; the safe mapper normalizes compact chapters, preserves direct NPC descriptions, rewrites player-facing story labels, and chooses a non-hero cast member for opening dialogue when possible.

score.basis: new-world creation and one-turn replay now show generated world/NPC/event material flowing into dialogue, proactive NPC contact and recommendations; the increase is intentionally limited because mechanics still come from the vetted hybrid skeleton
